The '''73rd Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievement in feature [[Film director|films]], [[Documentary film|documentary]], [[Television director|television]] and [[Television advertisement|commercials]] of 2020, were presented virtually on April 10, 2021.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Vary |first1=Adam B. |title=Chloé Zhao Wins Top DGA Award for 'Nomadland' |url=https://variety.com/2021/film/news/dga-awards-winners-list-directors-guild-1234948698/ |access-date=April 11, 2021 |work=Variety |date=April 10, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Keegan |first1=Rebecca |last2=Lewis |first2=Hilary |title=DGA Awards: Chloe Zhao and 'Nomadland' Take Top Honor |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/2021-dga-awards-winners-list |access-date=April 11, 2021 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=April 10, 2021}}</ref> The nominations for the television and documentary categories were announced on March 8, 2021,<ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Television, Commercials and Documentary for 2020 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2021/2100308-73rd-Annual-DGA-Awards-Television-Nominees-Announced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=March 8, 2021 |date=March 8, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Lewis |first1=Hilary |title=DGA Awards: 'Ted Lasso,' 'Curb Your Enthusiasm' Score Two TV Nominations Apiece |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/2021-dga-awards-documentary-tv-commercial-nominations |access-date=March 8, 2021 |work=The Hollywood Reporter |date=March 8, 2021}}</ref> while the nominations for the feature film categories were announced on March 9, 2021.<ref>{{cite web |title=DGA Announces Nominees for Outstanding Directorial Achievement in Theatrical Feature Film for 2020 |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2021/210309_73rdAnnualDGAAwardsFeatureFilmNomineesAnnounced.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=March 9, 2021 |date=March 9, 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Pedersen |first1=Erik |title=DGA Awards Film Nominations: 'Nomadland', 'Minari', 'Mank', 'Chicago 7' & 'Promising Young Woman' Helmers Vie For Top Prize |url=https://deadline.com/2021/03/dga-awards-film-nominations-2021-1234709909/ |website=Deadline |access-date=March 9, 2021 |date=March 9, 2021}}</ref>
